name: @pipeworx/mcp-exa

tools.name: search
tools.description: Neural/semantic web search — find pages by meaning, not just keywords. Returns title, URL, published date, author, and relevance score. Optionally retrieve clean page text inline. Example: search({ query: "startups building AI agents for customer support", num_results: 10, type: "neural" })

query.description: The search query — describe what you want by meaning, e.g. "recent research on protein folding with diffusion models"

num_results.description: Number of results to return (default 10, max 25)

include_text.description: If true, include the clean parsed page text (up to 2000 chars) for each result. Default false.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Exa API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: get_contents
tools.description: Retrieve clean, parsed page contents (text) for one or more Exa result IDs or URLs. Use after search to read the full content of pages. Example: get_contents({ ids: ["https://example.com/article"] })

ids.description: An Exa result ID or URL, or an array of them.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Exa API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: find_similar
tools.description: Find pages similar to a given URL using neural/semantic matching. Returns title, URL, relevance score, and published date. Example: find_similar({ url: "https://example.com/great-article", num_results: 10 })

url.description: The URL to find semantically similar pages for.

num_results.description: Number of results to return (default 10, max 25)

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Exa API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-exa forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the exa pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
